_note: Clearance register. verdict must be CLEAR before any pipeline stage may use a source. Verified 2026-08-17 against primary licence text. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-17-anatomy-atlas-spec.md section 9.
_tier: B+ : nothing named in the slice viewer or catalog; one credit line on the RadioAnatome info screen; third-party notices in Settings > Legal.

visible-human.licence: US Government work, no copyright; NLM download Terms and Conditions apply
visible-human.credit: Courtesy of the U.S. National Library of Medicine
visible-human.note: Licence agreement requirement was dropped in 2019. The credit obligation is contractual (from the download T&C), not copyright.

wikimedia-cc0.note: Only files whose extmetadata License is pd or cc0. Keep the extmetadata blob per file as an audit record; Commons tags are user-asserted and sometimes wrong.

totalsegmentator-total.licence: Apache-2.0 (code and the total / total_mr weights)
totalsegmentator-total.note: Run on our own PD images ONLY. Never run on the CC BY 4.0 training dataset, so nothing shipped is an adaptation of it.

fastsurfer-segonly.note: --seg_only (asegdkt, cereb) needs NO FreeSurfer licence. The SURFACE pipeline does; never invoke it. Weights licence as distinct from code is UNVERIFIED, and its training labels are FreeSurfer-derived.

synthseg-v1.note: v1.0 ONLY. The 2.0 / robust / parc weights come from a separate link with no licence statement: UNVERIFIED, do not use. Take from GitHub, never from a FreeSurfer bundle.

grays-1918.licence: Public domain in the US (published before 1931)
grays-1918.note: Source from an ORIGINAL 1918 scan. NOT Project Gutenberg (trademark notice + 20% commercial royalty clause). NOT Wikisource wikitext (editor annotations are BY-SA). EU/UK status unclear until 2035 if W. H. Lewis is editor of record.

terminologia-anatomica-terms.licence: Individual terms are explicitly public domain
terminologia-anatomica-terms.note: TERMS ONLY. The TA2 document is CC BY-ND: never redistribute the PDF or a wholesale copy of its hierarchy.

spl-nac-brain-atlas.note: 300+ hand-labelled structures; highest-quality single source. Part B 1(b) notice goes in Settings > Legal.

fsl.blocking_clause: Non-commercial. Clauses (2)/(3) reach the DEVELOPMENT PROCESS: using FSL to generate coordinates for a commercial product is caught even if no FSL code ships.

jhu-icbm-dti-81.blocking_clause: Distributed under the FSL licence; independent non-FSL terms UNVERIFIED. This is why named white matter is hand-authored.

freesurfer.blocking_clause: Part B 1(b) forces MGH-prefaced licence text into user documentation. Also states clinical applications are neither recommended nor advised. Use fastsurfer-segonly instead.

tcia.blocking_clause: No CC0 collection found. CC BY 4.0 s3(a) attribution plus a mandatory DOI citation.

fma.blocking_clause: CC BY attribution. Licensor's own page is offline; version taken from OBO Foundry, so PARTIALLY UNVERIFIED.

uberon.blocking_clause: CC BY attribution. The LICENSE file is unambiguous even though GitHub's detector reports NOASSERTION.

wikipedia.blocking_clause: Attribution plus share-alike, which would force our derived text under BY-SA.

mindboggle-101.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 (paper) vs CC BY 4.0 (site) - conflicting
mindboggle-101.blocking_clause: Unresolved conflicting licence claims; under the paper's version it is non-commercial AND share-alike. Encumbers the DKT40 classifier.

totalsegmentator-brain-structures.licence: Proprietary; free for non-commercial, paid commercial licence required
totalsegmentator-brain-structures.blocking_clause: Not covered by the Apache-2.0 grant. Commercial use requires purchase. Use fastsurfer-segonly or synthseg-v1 for brain structures.

radiopaedia.blocking_clause: Non-commercial only. Free-to-students distribution inside a commercial app does not qualify.
